episode_row: CI deploy gate blocked a deploy (lockfile/TZ)

commits.subject: ci: pin uv to 0.11.6 (production box version) so --locked accepts the lockfile
commits.body:
setup-uv@v5 pulled a newer uv that interprets the date-only exclude-newer as
00:00Z instead of the lockfile's 04:00Z, so `uv sync --locked` rejected uv.lock
and the test gate failed before deploying (production untouched). Pin CI's uv to
the box's 0.11.6 so resolution is byte-identical.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: ci: run in America/New_York so --locked accepts the lockfile
commits.body:
The date-only exclude-newer is resolved in local time; uv.lock is generated on
ET machines (box + Mac), so a UTC runner shifted the timestamp 04:00Z->00:00Z
and --locked rejected it (verified: uv lock --check passes under TZ=America/
New_York, fails under TZ=UTC). Set TZ=America/New_York on both CI jobs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
